Transaction execution, account loading, fee validation, and instruction stack checks.

# Purpose
This file implements the main transaction execution logic for the executor. It sets up transaction accounts, resolves address lookup tables, validates fee payers, checks account locks, enforces rent and loaded-account size rules, and runs the instruction execution loop. It also handles native program lookup, including built-in programs, precompiles, and BPF loader programs, by using perfect-hash lookup tables over program public keys. The file defines the public executor entry points used by the runtime, such as [`fd_executor_check_transactions`](<#fd_executor_check_transactions>), [`fd_executor_verify_transaction`](<#fd_executor_verify_transaction>), [`fd_executor_load_transaction_accounts`](<#fd_executor_load_transaction_accounts>), [`fd_execute_txn`](<#fd_execute_txn>), and [`fd_executor_txn_check`](<#fd_executor_txn_check>).

The code also contains support logic for instruction stack management, cross-program invocation checks, rollback fee payer setup, transaction fee calculation, and error-to-string mapping for instruction failures. Several functions mirror Agave runtime behavior and apply feature-gated rules for transaction loading, executable account checks, and fee handling. The file is therefore a central executor implementation file, not a header, and it provides the core transaction validation and execution path for the runtime.
